displayName: Job Order (dispatched job on one machine)
description: Level-3 MOM JobOrder (ISA-95 Part 4 / B2MML JobOrder): the job of one machine within a Workorder (WorkRequest) = one workorder operation. The lots it produces point to it (MaterialLot.job_order_ref).

properties.name: job_order_no
properties.description: Identity of the JobOrder (join key): its own number from the source system. It is never built from other keys; the Workorder is reached through workorder_ref (PART_OF).

properties.name: workorder_ref
properties.description: The Workorder (WorkRequest) this job belongs to.

properties.name: machine_ref
properties.description: The machine (Equipment) the job runs on.

properties.name: work_master_ref
properties.description: The work master the job runs by (FOR_WORK_MASTER; ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 7 JobOrder.WorkMasterID). Optional.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Dispatch state of the job as the source names it.

properties.name: segment_requirement_ref
properties.description: The SegmentRequirement (FOR_SEGMENT_REQUIREMENT; ISA-95 JobOrder → SegmentRequirement). Optional.

properties.name: job_list_ref
properties.description: The JobList this JobOrder is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 JobList MADE_UP_OF JobOrder). Optional.

properties.name: equipment_class_ref
properties.description: The EquipmentClass (REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT; ISA-95 JobOrder → EquipmentClass). Optional.

properties.name: material_class_ref
properties.description: The MaterialClass (REQUIRES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 JobOrder → MaterialClass). Optional.

properties.name: article_ref
properties.description: The Article (REQUIRES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 JobOrder → MaterialDefinition). Optional.

properties.name: quant_ref
properties.description: The Quant (REQUIRES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 JobOrder → MaterialSubLot). Optional.

properties.name: person_ref
properties.description: The Person (REQUIRES_PERSONNEL; ISA-95 JobOrder → Person). Optional.

properties.name: personnel_class_ref
properties.description: The PersonnelClass (REQUIRES_PERSONNEL; ISA-95 JobOrder → PersonnelClass). Optional.

properties.name: tool_ref
properties.description: The Tool (REQUIRES_PHYSICAL_ASSET; ISA-95 JobOrder → PhysicalAsset). Optional.

properties.name: physical_asset_class_ref
properties.description: The PhysicalAssetClass (REQUIRES_PHYSICAL_ASSET; ISA-95 JobOrder → PhysicalAssetClass). Optional.

properties.name: test_specification_ref
properties.description: The TestSpecification (TESTED_BY; ISA-95 JobOrder → TestSpecification). Optional.

properties.name: work_type
properties.description: ISA-95 work type (B2MML WorkType, the OperationsType code list; Part 4; audit M1). A source without the column sets the constant of the profile's momDomain (columnMappings const).

relationships.description: The Workorder this job is part of (ISA-95: WorkRequest MADE_UP_OF JobOrder).
The machine the job runs on (B2MML EquipmentRequirement).

The lots the job requires or consumes (B2MML MaterialRequirement; a made lot is a JobResponse ACTUAL_MATERIAL, audit L3); 1:n, the key sits on the lot (MaterialLot.job_order_ref). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/job-order.md, relationships › REQUIRES_MATERIAL.
The work master the job runs by (B2MML JobOrder.WorkMasterID).

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 4 JobOrder = one dispatched job of a WorkRequest; its MaterialLot link is JobOrder REQUIRES_MATERIAL MaterialLot, keyed on the lot side. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/job-order.md, isa95 › note.
isa95.mappingNote: The parent WorkRequest is carried by B2MML through the nesting of JobOrder in WorkRequest, not as a field. Actuals are reported per order and operation (Part 2 SegmentResponse); Part 4 actuals need a source keyed by job. Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent).
